label: Permissibility assignment governed by a principle: P k holds exactly when the principle holds of…
definition: Governs X F P: for every scenario k, intervening in k is permissible under the assignment P exactly when the principle X holds of the case description F k. P is a supplied assignment for intervening only; refraining is not evaluated, and absence of permission is impermissibility of intervening.
